message:
fix(comply): the index summary page was missing its evidence-domain table

The previous commit wired `by_section` into the framework pages and the
narrative prompt, but never into `index_page`. Regenerating the site therefore
faithfully re-rendered a summary page with no breakdown on it — the executive
prose described per-domain determinacy that no table on that page showed.

The index now carries the cross-framework domain table, placed BEFORE the
per-framework totals. The two answer different questions: the framework table
says how complete each framework is, the domain table says how much of what a
repository can evidence this project evidences. Only the second is actionable,
so it leads.

Three tests, because the absence of one is what let this ship: the breakdown
renders, it precedes the framework table, and an empty rollup omits it rather
than emitting a stray empty table.

Published figures — Code 36 controls at 75% determinacy, Infrastructure 37 at
49%, Documentation 3 at 67%, Organizational 35 at 0%.

Verified: 1146 tests green, clippy clean, leak scan clean over every page.
